request: Fix the intermittent audit-baseline test failures: isolate the default-tier live-tree writers (build-template.sh --manifest-only in manifest-refresh.test.mjs, npm run build:site in the site tests) so they stop racing the audit's reads of obj/template/.claude/manifest.json and obj/site/**; close the two blind spots in tests/no-live-objtemplate-reads.test.mjs (variable-indirected build invocations; build:site excluded despite docsite-drift.mjs now reading obj/site); and add failure-capture instrumentation so a surviving mechanism is caught with evidence next time.
novelty_evidence: The mitigation already exists in-repo: landmine `live-objtemplate-rebuild-races-parallel-test-readers` prescribes it (mitigations 1 and 2); `tests/build-template.test.mjs` + `tests/build-template-build-id.test.mjs` + `tests/template-payload.test.mjs` isolate live builds via the PKG_ROOT override into a mkdtemp root; `tests/helpers/clone-and-build.mjs` is the shipped isolation helper; the 2026-06-05 reduce-test-suite-runtime landing gated the npm-pack writers behind PUBLISH_TESTS and added `tests/no-live-objtemplate-reads.test.mjs` as the regression guard. This change copies that pattern onto two writers the guard misses. Backlog key: full-suite-intermittently-fails-three-audit-spawning-tests.
